limits: no L07 dispatcher lease or writer token
no exact pilot command signature, procedure binding, transaction owner or hook order proved
no authorized raw SQL/source/runtime opened or executed
no database mutation, lock test or legacy command dispatch
no product code, CI or current-head implementation test
no GitHub mutation or issue closure
objective: Define dedupe identity and mismatch handling without claiming exactly-once behavior.

cases.scenario: same domain/key and identical semantic payload while first InProgress
cases.expected: return same operation/InProgress; do not dispatch again

cases.scenario: same domain/key and identical payload after Success
cases.expected: reauthorize result access and return reconciled original outcome

cases.scenario: same key with changed semantic payload
same key in different tenant/company/data source
cases.expected: distinct scoped domain; no cross-scope result access
does not grant access or dedupe authority across principals unless explicit command contract says so
current authority revalidated; old success record grants no permission
dispatch/result fenced separately; logical harmful effect is not recreated automatically

cases.scenario: key expires while operation InProgress or OutcomeUnknown
cases.expected: cannot become empty/reusable; reconcile or retain safe tombstone

cases.scenario: semantic fingerprint changes only JSON field order/format
cases.expected: canonical command-specific normalization yields same meaning where explicitly defined

cases.scenario: payload changes a business-significant default omitted by client
cases.expected: server-resolved value participates in semantic fingerprint as contract requires

cases.scenario: external ledger reservation succeeds but business dispatch never starts
cases.expected: terminal/retry disposition follows verified command policy; no fake business success

cases.scenario: business commit succeeds but external ledger update fails
cases.expected: OutcomeUnknown/reconciliation; external ledger alone cannot claim exactly once

cases.scenario: ledger query includes semantic fingerprint in lookup uniqueness, so changed payload misses the existing stable key
cases.expected: validator/design rejects lookup; stable scoped key finds the existing record and immutable fingerprint mismatch is rejected before dispatch

cases.scenario: same idempotency key and fingerprint digest but different canonicalizer/contract version
cases.expected: contract/canonicalizer version is bound; incompatible fingerprint domains never collide silently

cases.scenario: browser submits its own semantic fingerprint
cases.expected: server recomputes from typed payload, authoritative defaults/scope and action contract; client digest grants no dedupe identity

cases.scenario: hash collision or canonicalization ambiguity is detected
cases.expected: fail closed to manual/explicit conflict; never return or dispatch against an ambiguous operation

fingerprint_contract.algorithm: versioned canonicalization plus collision-resistant digest; exact algorithm selected in implementation review
fingerprint_contract.lookup_behavior: lookup by stable scoped ledger key, then compare the immutable stored fingerprint; mismatch is rejected before dispatch and is never a miss or new reservation

lookup_sequence: lookup by stable scoped ledger key
if absent reserve one operation record
reject mismatch before dispatch; never reserve a second record for the same key
reauthorize before result disclosure or replay decision
